# 4 Ezra Chapter 11 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Eagle vision (Rome)

---

**1** I had a dream. A great eagle rose up from the sea. It had twelve feathered wings and three heads.

**2** I watched as it spread its wings across the entire earth. Every wind in the sky blew against it. Storm clouds gathered all around it.

**3** As I watched, more wings grew out from the sides — smaller wings, little secondary ones.

**4** Its three heads were still, resting. The middle head was the largest, but it rested alongside the others.

**5** And the eagle launched itself on its wings to rule over the earth and everyone living on it.

**6** I saw how everything under heaven was brought into submission to it. Nothing spoke against it — not a single creature on earth.

**7** The eagle stood on its talons and spoke to its feathers:

**8** Do not all wake at once. Each of you sleep in your place and rise in turn. But save the heads for last.

**9** And I noticed the voice did not come from its heads but from the middle of its body.

**10** I counted the opposing wings on the other side: there were eight of them.

**11** On the right side one wing rose up and ruled over the entire earth.

**12** When it had reigned long enough it ended and vanished without a trace. The next one rose and reigned — and this one held power for a long time.

**13** When its time came it too ended and vanished, like the first.

**14** Then a voice came to it and said:

**15** Listen — you who have held power over the earth all this time! Before you vanish I have this to tell you:

**16** No ruler after you will reign as long as you did. Not even half as long.

**17** Then the third rose and reigned like the ones before it — and it too disappeared.

**18** And so it went through all the wings, one after another, each rising to power and then vanishing.

**19** Then in due course the wings on the right side rose up too. Some of them reigned briefly and vanished; others arose but could not hold on to power.

**20** After that I watched all twelve wings and the two small wings disappear.

**21** Nothing was left of the eagle's body except the three resting heads and six small wings.

**22** Then two of the small wings separated from the six and took their position under the right-side head. The remaining four stayed where they were.

**23** I could see the four smaller wings plotting to set themselves up and seize power.

**24** One rose — then instantly disappeared.

**25** A second one — gone even faster than the first.

**26** The two remaining ones were still scheming to take power,

**27** when suddenly the middle head — the one that had been resting, the one larger than the other two — woke up.

**28** I watched it draw the other two heads into alliance with itself.

**29** Then the head turned with its allies and devoured the two small wings that had been positioning themselves for power.

**30** This head then seized control of the whole earth and crushed everyone on it with brutal oppression. It exercised more power over the world than any of the wings before it.

**31** Then even this middle head suddenly disappeared, the same way the wings had.

**32** Two heads were left, and they in the same manner ruled the earth and its inhabitants.

**33** Then I watched as the right-side head devoured the left one.

**34** A voice said to me: Look ahead — watch what you are seeing.

**35** I looked, and from the forest a creature like a lion came charging out with a roar. It raised its voice — a human voice — to the eagle and said:

**36** Listen to me. I have a message for you. This is what the Most High says:

**37** Are you not what remains of the four beasts I set up to rule my world, so that through them the last of my appointed times would be reached?

**38** You are the fourth beast, the one that conquered all who came before you, that held dominion over the world through terror and over all the earth through merciless oppression.

**39** You spent all this time in the world operating through lies, and your judgment over the earth was never just.

**40** You crushed the weak. You harmed the peaceful. You despised the honest and embraced the deceitful. You demolished the homes of productive people and tore down the walls of people who never harmed you.

**41** Your arrogance has climbed all the way to the Most High. Your pride has reached the Mighty One himself.

**42** And the Most High has looked at his appointed times — and they are complete. His ages have run their course.

**43** Therefore you are going to disappear, eagle — you and your dreadful wings, your loathsome feathers, your wicked heads, your terrible claws, your entire worthless body —

**44** so that the whole earth can breathe again, freed from your crushing grip, refreshed and renewed, with hope for the judgment and mercy of the one who made it.
